result.reason: The addition largely tracks the preferred position by providing six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and requiring machine-readable data return, deletion, and certification. However, data return is due within 30 days after Customer's request rather than within 30 days after expiry or termination. More importantly, termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Customer data, even though the Agreement and other attachments may remain active. This conflicts with the original clause's preservation of unaffected Service Option Attachments and should be limited to data associated with the terminated services. The drafting is otherwise generally professional.
